headings: Prism 11 vs Prism 10: what is different
1. What you notice first: the interface
2. The big addition: long-format (Multiple variables) data as a full workflow
2.2 Classic analyses straight from long-format data, 11.0.0, Pro
4. Graphs: what changed and what did not
9. About the Prism 10 install on this Mac [verified]

requirements.title: Welcome CLOUD group, Collaborate and power entry points
acceptance: CLOUD sits between CREATE and LEARN; distinguish cloud links from locally implemented table creation.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Multiple-variable tutorial catalogue
acceptance: Track all 20 tutorials, including formulas, long-format paired t, multifactor/effect sizes, nonlinear and KM examples.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 context toolbar layout
acceptance: Data panel: Transform/fx, Change Row Order, Create Series, Exclude Values / Decimal Format. Print and LA panels removed from every sheet; Draw removed from data. Send groups LabArchives/Luma; print remains in File.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 menu and shortcut changes
acceptance: Unified Import; clone-family wording; calculated-variable = shortcut; unlink calculated variable; variable types/column widths/titles/subcolumn titles/Tan; number-at-risk actions; revised Help/Share names.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Result tabs with close controls
acceptance: Replace results dropdown-style assumptions with real named subtabs and correct close/reopen/persistence behavior; compare native semantics before deleting result data.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Variable header names, type icons and data Inspector
acceptance: Multiple-variable placeholder Name versus classic Column Title; label/categorical/continuous types; inspector edits calculated columns.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Freeze raw data tables
acceptance: Frozen raw tables reject edits; update Prism10 conflicting claim rather than treating it as confirmed old behavior.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Shift+Cmd+Arrow stops at first empty cell
acceptance: Test gaps, excluded cells, first/last cell, selection extension and browser shortcut constraints.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Version-specific recent files, scripts and diagnostics
acceptance: Keep GP storage versioned and distinguish imported reference app logs/settings; do not conflate Prism10 and11 recent files.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Calculated-variable Inspector, dependencies and unlink
acceptance: Only Multiple-variable tables allow formulas; = and fx open editor; name expression variable highlights searchable functions; italic fx outputs recalculate; unlink preserves materialized values.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: qPCR calculation and plain-text transform roundtrip
acceptance: C-D, E-F and 2^(-G) cascade through rows/analyses/graphs; transform field persists exactly with identity-safe references and missing/error behavior.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Long-format classic analyses and grouped fits
acceptance: Assign response/factor/subject/X/time/event variables for t/nonparametric, multifactor, nonlinear and KM; each categorical combination has the correct analysis/fit without silent wide pivot.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Multifactor Type III model design and interactions
acceptance: Arbitrary factor count, configured main/two-/three-way terms, unbalanced TypeIII SS, coding/rank checks; explicitly no multifactor repeated-measures support.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Multifactor comparison families and automatic graphs
acceptance: Main/simple/cell comparisons; proper corrections and CI tables; auto grouped bar and Dunnett-style comparison CI plot linked to results.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Expanded ANOVA effect sizes
acceptance: eta-squared, partial eta-squared, Cohen f per relevant effect and design; verify denominators and any intervals rather than aliasing all formulas.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: t-test and contingency effect sizes
acceptance: Report-effect-sizes option: Cohen d, Hedges g, unpaired Glass delta; contingency phi and Cramer V with CIs and verified conventions.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Long-format categorical graph families and layers
acceptance: All 11 Multiple variables types: scatter, strip, summary-symbol, bar+strip, before-after bar+strip, before-after strip, box/whisker, violin, bar, bubble, heat map. Configure X/Y variable type, color definition, composable summary/error/connecting layers and mean/median/geometric summaries with appropriate SD/SEM/CI/range/IQR.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Long-format category Level Order and compatibility
acceptance: Level Order: entry, row, name, frequency, manual; access from Variable Types and legend context. Persist role/order mapping; no assumed automatic P annotations; report empty old-version graphs and no-pzfx support.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: GG correction of one-RM-factor two-way interaction
acceptance: Use corrected interaction dfs/P under target11.1, compare uncorrected and earlier-version references; test epsilon limits and sphericity settings.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Lognormal comparison families
acceptance: Lognormal unpaired/Welch/one-sample ratio/multiple t; ordinary/Brown-Forsythe-Welch/RM one-way. Normal/Lognormal/Nonparametric distribution choice; positive-domain checks, geometric means/ratios/transformed intervals.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Survival number-at-risk and censor table
acceptance: Add/format/remove table below X axis; align times, at-risk/censor counts, shaded CI bands and medianCI; verify event/censor tie boundary conventions.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Survival pairwise comparisons and median uncertainty
acceptance: Pairwise families and adjustments plus95% median intervals; preserve censoring and undefined median cases.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Fixed-slope-one Gaddum/Schild models
acceptance: Catalogue specific fixed-slope variants, constraints and derived affinity/shift parameters; validate saved examples and slope interpretation.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Fractional confidence levels
acceptance: Allow99.9% and other supported decimal confidence values in dialog/spec/save/analysis; do not round to integers.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Ineffective correction explanations and q-based discovery flags
acceptance: Two-way outputs explain when correction has no effect; nested one-way discoveries follow q, not raw P; regression tests straddle thresholds.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Categorical-interaction multiple-regression ANOVA table
acceptance: Full term-level ANOVA for categorical interactions with correct coding/df and model terms.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Format Axes continuity and expanded decimal controls
acceptance: Retain five-tab behavior and native origin/autorange semantics; add appropriate decimal precision fields and formatting tests.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Log-Y change selects geometric summary/error defaults
acceptance: Linear-to-log changes default summary/errors to geometric mean with geometricSD/CI in applicable families including Column; verify scope, override persistence and nonpositive data.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Small and dashed error bars
acceptance: Render error bars shorter than symbols; support solid/dash/dot where available and verify per-family native applicability.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Magic copies graph/X/Y titles separately
acceptance: Independent title-copy switches preserve other text and live constants unless selected.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Reopen one-row autoscale regression
acceptance: Opening saved one-row table/graph recomputes correct automatic range, no stale or degenerate limits.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Custom-axis nonlinear confidence-band clipping
acceptance: Compute/render bands across intended custom range, clip only at selected plotting bounds.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Repeated-source layout graph placement stability
acceptance: Two or more graphs sharing one table render/update/save/open/export in a layout without crash or link corruption.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Vector layout text and reference-band shading
acceptance: EPS text remains vector where supported; fill-between-extra-tick-and-Y shades correct region for signs/reversed/log axes.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 container format/minimum-version stamps
acceptance: Observed1-6-1 current stamps; classiccontentmin10.1, formulasmin11.0, observedmultifactormin11.1; version based on actual features, not blanket success.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: PCFF graph/layout continuity cross-check
acceptance: Author reports same99members/chunk types for resaved sample; obtain/compare actual artifacts before treating offsets as generally compatible.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Older-version frozen/empty feature behavior
acceptance: Compatibility warnings distinguish editable/view-only/frozen/empty/unsupported and .pzfx losses; native old-version opening requires runtime test.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Info slash-value save defect and result-row changes
acceptance: Test slash-containing Info constants in pzf/pzfx versus prism; preserve originals and expose lossy compatibility instead of silently corrupting. Version-index WCell/WRow row mappings.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Explicit Prism version selection for native automation
acceptance: Avoid ambiguous sharedbundleidentifier; adapters address exact app version and capture version in outputs.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 SVG script export and core script semantics
acceptance: Open/CreateLog/Save/GoTo/PNG/PDF execute in intended target; ExportSVG produces actual vector editable text; do not carry forward10.3SVGfailure as11limitation.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Script resolution quantization
acceptance: Measure exported pixels for150/400→300ppi and600→600, plus supported300/600/1200; retain size/unit assumptions.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Script loop placement and dotted filename fixes
acceptance: InsertData in ForEachSheet with4+tables targetscorrecttable/cells; export preserves full dotted sheet-derived filename.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: No invented native commands for new features
acceptance: No native formula/multifactor/levelorder/effectsize commands assumed; any GP extension explicitly namespaced and does not count as native command parity.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 cloud/Luma/browser-login integrations
acceptance: Track Collaborate/publication/unlink/Luma send-configure-signin/browserSSO as genuine external dependencies; no fake authentication or license gate.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Plan/version/platform and entitlement reference matrix
acceptance: Reference host macOS12+; record licensed feature availability for correct comparison; scientific implementation is not copied license enforcement; read-only/export behavior of Procontent requires native fixtures.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Unverified delta behaviors and missing reference files
acceptance: New graph settings/Level Order/effects/log defaults/dashed scope/older opening remain author-unverified. Ten screenshots are now embedded in companion HTML; associated projects/research dumps are still missing. Inspect images without treating them as interaction traces.
Retain Prism version and reference evidence; author [seen] is not a GP-agent runtime observation.

requirements.title: Prism 11 Settings changes
acceptance: Remove Paste a Graph from Another Project as option from File & Printer; licence-tab Luma connection is external; other retained preferences need regression checks.

requirements.title: Formula blank/error/reference semantics
acceptance: All 82 resource functions; arithmetic/comparison precedence; blanks stay blank; unknown names, deleted-column #REF! and cycles produce distinct diagnostics and never corrupt original data.

requirements.title: Restricted mean survival time
acceptance: Implement RMST with explicit restriction horizon, integration/counts, uncertainty and comparison options only where supported by versioned evidence; acquire native fixtures.

requirements.title: Optimal K-means cluster count
acceptance: Inventory approximately20 source indices including gap, silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz; specify candidate k, repetitions, random seeds, tie/degeneracy and index recommendations; do not imply the named3 exhaust the catalogue.

requirements.title: Regression profile-likelihood versus Wald confidence intervals
acceptance: Multiple linear, logistic and Cox per-source supported CI choices; asymmetry, optimizer/convergence and boundary tests; verify exactly which model outputs support each option.

requirements.title: Custom symbol shapes and older-version compatibility
acceptance: Persist custom shapes in scene and native metadata, render/export them correctly and report older-version warnings; verify allowed shape definition/limits.

requirements.title: Prism 11 error-bar diagnostics
acceptance: Some error bars may not be visible; distinguish clipped-axis-limit and log-axis notes, keep calculations intact, and compare relevant screenshots/settings.

requirements.title: Hidden unreleased Copilot reference boundary
acceptance: Record hidden CopilotEnabled/toggleCopilot and author-reported graph lookup/create/Magic/title tools; keep disabled by default as reference. No analysis/data-edit tools assumed. No probing or enabling prerelease GraphPad service; any future integration requires actual supported authorized interface.

requirements.title: Modified Prism 10 reference provenance
acceptance: Record author report of added activation-hook library and non-GraphPad signature. Recheck behavior-sensitive references against signed Prism11 or independent fixtures. Do not reproduce licensing bypass, execute injected library, or equate author claims with locally verified signatures.
